title: AI agents in 60 seconds
caption: AI agents in 60 seconds: a language model in a loop with tools, and why the loop is the whole trick. #ai #aiagents #llm

scenes.title: AI agents
scenes.say: A chatbot answers. An agent gets things done. What's the difference?
scenes.sub: A chatbot answers. An agent gets things done. What's the difference?

scenes.say: A chatbot answers. An agent does things. The difference isn't a smarter model. It's a loop.

items.title: Think
items.say: The model decides what to do next.

items.title: Act
items.say: It calls a tool: search, run code, click a button.

items.title: Observe
items.say: It reads the result, and goes round again until the job is done.

scenes.say: The model never touches the world directly. It writes a request, and your code runs it.

scenes.text: Give an agent kaviri's MCP server, and it can *film a demo video* of the app it just built.
scenes.say: One neat tool for an agent: kaviri. Give it kaviri's MCP server, and it can film a demo video of the app it just built.
